text: The Levi-Civita connection is the unique torsion-free connection that is compatible with the ___, meaning ∇_ρ g_μν = 0.
explanation: Metric compatibility, ∇_ρ g_μν = 0, together with vanishing torsion, uniquely fixes the Levi-Civita connection and its Christoffel symbols. Compatibility means the metric is covariantly constant, so parallel transport preserves inner products (lengths and angles). This is the connection used throughout general relativity.
